description: Star a record or database for the calling identity, or remove a star. Starring is how a person finds something again; an unstarred new database is one they have to go looking for. Stars are per-person: this cannot star anything for a teammate.

database.description: Required when target_type is "record" and `target` is a public number.

starred.description: true (default) to star, false to unstar.

target.description: Database name/slug/id, or a record uuid.

name: set_favorite
title: Star or unstar
